subject.title: fix(github-copilot): fail closed on unvalidated OAuth enterprise domain

question: Should invalid GitHub Copilot enterpriseUrl values already stored in canonical auth profiles silently fall back to github.com, or require an explicit diagnostic and repair path?
rationale: The PR correctly stops attacker-controlled egress, but current policy does not settle whether persistent invalid enterprise state may remain hidden behind a trusted-host fallback during upgrades.

options.title: Fallback with diagnostics
options.body: Keep the existing github.com fallback contract, add a clear warning and doctor repair for persisted invalid values, and prove the upgrade paths before merge.

options.title: Reject until repaired
options.body: Abort credential use for invalid persisted domains and require doctor to rewrite or remove the value before retrying.

options.title: Accept silent fallback
options.body: Merge the current behavior while intentionally accepting persistent invalid state and potentially opaque public-endpoint authentication failures.

recommendation.title: Fallback with diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep the existing github.com fallback contract, add a clear warning and doctor repair for persisted invalid values, and prove the upgrade paths before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared allowlist and adjacent migration behavior appear to originate in this recent current-main work.
